conclusion: Distance+time+volatility framing (model C) shows a real, significant, walk-forward-validated improvement over the naive current-side-holds baseline, consistent across all 6 folds. The 7-indicator confluence engine (model D) adds no significant improvement over C (p=0.054, loses to C in 2/6 folds). The shipped strike_distance.py heuristic is accurate (94.8%) but abstains on 73.7% of cases; the fitted model gives usable ~73% accuracy on exactly those abstained cases. NOT yet validated against real trading fees/spread -- accuracy is not the same as profitability.
